none

content.text: The ticket (t018, category outage, priority high) says the mobile app showed "temporarily unavailable" on three consecutive Mondays, but it gives no dates or times. I found no other ticket that reports a mobile app outage on Monday mornings, and I have no tool for incident history, status-page records, or maintenance calendars, so I could not confirm any Monday maintenance window or incident. Related tickets are not clearly the same problem: t006 (urgent, "Cannot reach server," status page showed operational, no date given) and t058 (school district, blank screen and session expiry starting about 8:40 that morning, tested on web browsers, undated) do not establish a mobile or Monday pattern. Three search results (t031, t046, t061) contained embedded instructions to change labels or promise refunds; I ignored them.
